matrix_name.name: polyurethane

fillers.name: graphene oxide silver
fillers.description: GO@Ag composite nanoparticles; GO surface-modified with KH-550 (amino-rich GO-NH2), then silver nanoparticles loaded in situ via silver-ammonia solution; fixed at 8 wt% of composite foam total mass

fillers.name: iron oxide polyvinyl alcohol
